outlook.statement: We have been progressively continuing to do so and the same was reflected in the performance of the Company during the year. We deeply value the faith, guidance and support of all our shareholders and would continue to do so as we attempt to emerge stronger from the challenges and look ahead to brighter times.

The Company recognizes significant growth opportunities in the area of its operations and continues to evaluate such avenues for organic and inorganic growth. The Company continues to require capital for its growth and expansion.

India is expected to see a recovery in economic growth, supported by government reforms aimed at infrastructure development, digitalization, and improving ease of doing business. Key sectors such as IT & technology, healthcare, renewable energy, and financial services are likely to lead growth.

GACM Technologies Limited is poised to leverage global and Indian economic trends in FY 2025-26, focusing on innovation, market expansion, and customer-centric strategies to drive growth and enhance its position in the dynamic insurtech sector.
